Messages.Author: Andrew S. Davidson
Messages.Body:
"Unique master. Put this card in play. While in play, this card
represents a mortal ally with 1 life, 0 strength and 0 blood. During
your untap phase, you may burn Jake to move up to 4 blood from the
blood bank to a ready vampire with no blood."

He was the rare from one of my boosters and I was glad that the others
chose not to draft him before I got a chance. He doesn't seem as good
as Millicent or the MVH though and isn't much of a Hunter. What's
supposed to be going on here? The only incident that comes to mind is
when Buffy let Angel feed from her which put her in hospital. I think
I'm going to call him "Jake Whassup" - the guy to call when you feel
like a drink ...

Andrew

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <E4D9805C2CA3AB66.8C0E1B4D...@lp.airnews.net>,



As far as I can tell, he's an emergency blood bag -- an inept hunter,
if you will. He's also a perfectly adequate platform for things like
Cloaked Computer Hackings, chump blocking, or Vozhd (War Ghoul) fodder.
Since he's a master card in the ash heap, he can't be turned into
a Shambling Whore, and he's not Compellable, which is sub-optimal
as far as the Giovanni are concerned. And he's Cryptic Mission/Shadow
Twin bait, of course.

He's too fragile to last very long once in play, and the vampire
has to be empty at untap, which is not _that_ common of an occurrence
(low? yes. empty? not so often). So he's kind of marginal, all things
considered. But funny.

gomi
